headings.usage: Headers, main section titles, patient names. Avoid standard Inter.

body.usage: All body text, data points, charts, form inputs. Excellent legibility for clinical numbers.

labels.usage: Clinical metrics labels, overlines, status tags, table headers.

surfaces_and_shadows.strategy: Flat Solid Surfaces. NO Glassmorphism. Medical interfaces require absolute optical clarity.

layout_and_grids.dashboard: High Density Grid (Bento Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layout_and_grids.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) for readability. Tight gaps between highly correlated clinical data points.
layout_and_grids.alignment: Left-align clinical data and labels for easy scanning. Center only empty states.
layout_and_grids.mobile_strategy: Tablet-first (768-1024px optimized). Touch targets minimum 44px for operators who might be wearing gloves.

components.timeline: Custom HTML/Tailwind vertical timeline for Vascular Access history with distinct dot colors for events (e.g., Red for bleeding, Blue for creation).
components.telemetry_panel: Dense metric blocks. Use flash/pulse animation (e.g., bg-yellow-100 to transparent) on data update to signal real-time changes.
components.data_cards: Use 'Diff Badges' or subtle arrow icons (↑/↓) for contextualizing current vs previous sessions.
components.forms: Dense layout, use Shadcn primitives heavily customized for medical data entry. Group by logical clinical workflow (Before, During, After).

visual_enhancers.empty_states: Do not show blank screens. Show 'No prior data - Verify with patient' or similar clinical CTA.
visual_enhancers.data_context: Always pair current values with historical range. E.g., '300 mL/min' next to a small text '(Range: 320-350)'.
visual_enhancers.motion: Minimal. Focus on micro-interactions for feedback (button press, tab switch). No bouncy or playful animations. Medical UI must feel grounded and predictable.

login_background.description: Clean, modern clinic equipment for the login page background or side panel.

operator_avatar.description: Avatar for the logged-in dialysis procedure operator.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 minimum for normal text, 3:1 for large text. Text over any colored flag must be readable.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:ring-offset-1).

libraries_and_tools.charts: recharts for trends/historical ranges. Do not use D3 for simple line/bar charts.
libraries_and_tools.toast: sonner for WhatsApp dispatch notifications and telemetry alarms.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx files, so write React components in .js using standard JSX.
Prioritize data clarity over aesthetic flair. Use IBM Plex Sans for all data metrics to prevent number misreading.
Implement the 'Before, During, After' dialysis flow using Shadcn Tabs or a clear wizard progression.
Mock the telemetry data stream using React useEffect intervals to simulate live machine data.
For the Vascular Access panel, show a clear timeline of events using vertical line indicators.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Do not use generic SaaS blue for everything; restrict color usage to indicate status (red=alert, green=normal, blue=action).
Build a simulated 'Prescription Report' with a 'Clinician Sign-off' section.
Include a simulated WhatsApp send log UI component.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds over images where text needs to be read. Use solid backgrounds for clinical apps.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions like `transition-colors`, `transition-opacity`.
Ensure `sonner` is used for notifications (e.g., telemetry alerts, WhatsApp sent confirmation).
Include DPDP Act data-sharing consent checkbox on the Login screen.
